Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. If you possess an entrepreneurial spirit, a desire to lead by example, and a passion for building meaningful relationships with clients, we encourage you to apply. This is a hybrid role with the expectation to be in the office 1X / week.

New Business Development : Engage with new strategic accounts to uncover new revenue opportunities and develop customised solutions that meet the needs of Enterprise prospects (+501 FTEs in Germany).
Senior Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, Reward Directors, and Wellbeing leaders. Ensure that Wellhub is not only aligned with business goals but also drives tangible, measurable results.
Pipeline Generation : Work closely with our Sales Development team to strategise on opening new opportunities as well complete personal pipeline generation to ensure steady and consistent pipeline.
Account Strategy Developmen t: Develop and implement strategic account plans that focus on delivering impactful business outcomes—whether improving talent attraction, enhancing spend efficiency, or reducing Private Medical costs.
Industry Engagement: Represent Wellhub at key industry events, forums, and conferences, showcasing our vision and capabilities in shaping the future of Employee Wellbeing.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Proven Success in SaaS Sales: Experience in enterprise sales new logo acquisition(501+ FTEs in Germany ) with a strong track record of driving revenue growth and working on ticket sizes of £100K - £500K+.
Expertise in Strategic Account Management: Experience in managing complex sales cycles (6 months+), developing new business opportunities, and fostering long-term relationships within a target-driven environment.
Strong Stakeholder Engagement: Comfortably engage with C-suite executives, key decision-makers, and senior stakeholders across HR, finance, and business functions to align solutions with customer needs.
Complex Sales Expertise: Skilled at managing multi-phase sales cycles, navigating intricate procurement and compliance processes, and presenting compelling value propositions to senior leadership.
Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present them in an approachable and engaging way. Comfort and interest in using data effectively in the Sales process
Data & Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and present in a compelling way to prospects. Comfort in using commercial insight to recommend and simplify investment options to a prospect.
Passion for Learning: A deep enthusiasm for the Sales profession and how to constantly improve individually and collectively
A I-savvy: We are looking for an individual who is comfortable with generative tools and skilled at crafting effective prompts to enhance daily tasks.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in a complex sales cycle, strong analytical mindset and ability to uncover new revenue opportunities are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:
WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

* Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (fliessend) und Französisch (gute Kenntnisse); Englisch ist von Vorteil.
* Verkörperung unserer Werte: Care, Grit, Connection und Ingenuity.

About WorkWhile
WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs: the true backbone of the hospitality, catering, and event industries. These workers often face highly volatile schedules, sudden booking surges, minimum wage pay, and limited benefits, leading to financial instability.
WorkWhile identifies the best, most reliable hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life.

For high-volume catering companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate food service providers, and large-scale event producers, we provide instant access to a vetted, high-quality workforce to seamlessly scale up for major events and peak periods.

For workers, we provide stable income and unmatched benefits, including next-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and financial wellness tools.
We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work in hospitality and live events.

WorkWhile is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager - Hospitality to join our team and build long-term, trusting relationships with our enterprise hospitality and event clients.

This role is focused on managing a portfolio of high-volume accounts, including catering conglomerates, national contract food service providers, sports and entertainment venue operators, and premier event management groups, ensuring they have the right workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, major event rollouts, and sudden booking surges.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for hospitality enterprise accounts, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, high-stakes nature of food service, catering, and venue management.

Lead Account Relationship: Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for enterprise hospitality and event clients, including staffing planning, shift fulfillment, and ongoing labor strategy.
Build Executive & Regional Alignment: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with regional event/culinary directors, general managers, corporate food service directors, venue concessionaires, and VP-level operations leaders.
Understand Industry Dynamics: Develop a deep understanding of each client’s operational environment, including hyper-seasonal staffing volatility, last-minute event bookings/cancellations, variable labor costs, and guest service standards, to proactively meet their workforce needs.
Drive Contract Growth & Retention: Maintain and grow client accounts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across regional event sites, venue networks, multi-unit properties, or new culinary/hospitality labor categories.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Develop trusted advisor relationships with key hospitality accounts, aligning WorkWhile's workforce solutions to their operational goals, ROI targets, and guest experience standards.
Ensure Operational Excellence: Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts in line with strict client SLAs, worker reliability metrics, and service quality expectations for high-profile events.
Transparent Stakeholder Communication: Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal operations teams and enterprise client executives.
Track & Forecast Metrics: Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker attendance/performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue retention and expansion.
Deliver Business Reviews: Prepare regular account health reports and quarterly business reviews tailored to venue operators, contract food service executives, and catering leadership teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Sales team to expand WorkWhile's presence across new venue networks or regional operator groups, and collaborate with internal Operations teams to ensure fulfillment during peak periods (e.g., stadium game days, peak catering seasons, major conferences).
Issue Escalation & Resolution: Assist with challenging client requests or live-event operational escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize disruption to the guest experience.

Experience: 3+ years experience as an Account Manager, ideally within the contract food service, event management, catering, venue operations, or flexible workforce solutions industries.
Deep Hospitality & Event IQ: A profound understanding of the logistics behind large-scale catering, stadium operations, corporate dining, and how workforce reliability directly impacts guest experience and margin.
Executive Presence & Influence: Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels, from regional culinary directors and venue GMs to VP-level hospitality executives.
Multi-Unit Expertise: Experience managing multi-unit, enterprise-scale hospitality accounts, venue networks, or multi-city event portfolios.
Tech Stack Proficiency: Solid experience with CRM software (Salesforce or similar) and Google Suite.
Track Record of Growth: Proven track record of delivering client-focused labor solutions, maintaining high customer retention rates, and hitting revenue growth/expansion targets.
Agility & Attention to Detail: Ability to juggle multiple complex enterprise accounts and fast-moving event timelines while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Communication Skills: Excellent listening, negotiation, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.

About Alma
At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.
Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.
As the buy now, pay later leader in France and an active player in 10 European countries, we have empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.
With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ in ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we are just getting started!

This position is for a CDR based in Paris.
You will join Alma’s SMB Sales team, made up of more than 20 people, and more specifically our four-person Inbound team.
As the team continues to grow alongside Alma, you will have the opportunity to leverage your sales skills while continuing to learn, develop and receive support from experienced teammates. Your goal will be to become the best sales professional you can be, with the support of the wider Revenue organization.
You will also work alongside a European, multilingual and multi-country Revenue organization of more than 80 people, giving you the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across markets and cultures.

Since Alma was founded in 2019, the Inbound team has been a key pillar of our commercial growth. As an Inbound Account Executive , you will play a central role in helping SMB merchants across France and Europe discover, adopt and grow with Alma.
Your mission will be to turn inbound opportunities into long-term commercial relationships, from the first conversation to the first transaction.
Own the inbound sales cycle: qualify, understand and convert leads from different sources, focusing on merchants with less than €5 million in annual revenue.
Build and manage your pipeline: organize your time, prioritize opportunities and manage every lead from qualification through to the first sale.
Deliver consistent performance: work towards monthly, quarterly and annual targets while maintaining a high level of execution and delivering an excellent customer experience.
Master the art of selling: continuously sharpen your discovery, sales, negotiation and closing techniques through practice, coaching and feedback.
Become a trusted expert: develop a deep understanding of the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments industries, both in France and across Europe.
Grow with Alma: contribute to the continued development of the Inbound team and help shape the way we support and convert the next generation of Alma merchants.
This role is ideal for someone ambitious, curious and eager to take ownership, grow quickly and make a tangible impact on Alma’s growth.
You will work with
As an Inbound Account Executive , you’ll work with a range of tools to manage your activity, improve your sales performance and better understand our merchants:
Salesforce: our CRM, where you’ll manage your leads, pipeline and sales activity.
Gong: to automate parts of your workflow, record your calls and review them to continuously improve your sales techniques.
Aircall: to manage your day-to-day calls with prospects and merchants.
Slack: to communicate directly with your colleagues and collaborate across teams.
Google Workspace: for the day-to-day productivity and collaboration tools used across the team.
Looker: to access and analyze business and sales data.
Additional retail and merchant intelligence tools: you’ll discover these over time, alongside the wider teams, to deepen your understanding of our market and prospects.

To succeed in this job
Humility: you learn from your mistakes, welcome feedback and continuously improve alongside the team.
Autonomy: you can quickly take ownership of your pipeline, manage your opportunities and convert merchants independently.
Curiosity: you’re eager to understand the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments ecosystems in which Alma operates, and become a recognized expert in these areas.
Rigor: you pay attention to every step of the sales cycle and maintain high standards to deliver sustainable performance and exceed your targets.
And it would be a plus if you also
Language skills: you are bilingual in English and either bilingual or a native speaker of Spanish or German .
Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.
What’s in it for you
If you join us, you will have the opportunity to grow and make an impact through:
A true sales school: learn every day alongside experienced sales professionals and develop the skills, habits and mindset to build a successful career in one of France’s leading tech companies.
A high-performing, supportive team: join a close-knit and caring environment where people challenge, support and look after one another, with high standards and genuine attention to individual needs.
An ambitious and sustainable company: contribute to Alma’s ambition to scale across Europe profitably, within a stable and well-structured organization.
A career you can build: benefit from a clear and evolving career path, with the opportunity to grow, take on new responsibilities and thrive alongside Alma’s teams over the long term.
